LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionHelmet.description: A carefully designed and decorated helmet made out of a single large piece of wood or metal. A wide open gap near the mouth and eyes allows full peripheral vision and unmuffled communication. This particular helmet includes accoutrement to inspire both its wearers and onlookers, when fighting side by side a centurion even pain itself seems dulled.
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionHelmet.label: centurion helmet
